scope: The existing Saturday Spin P0 release plus the Not Done Yet application follow-up workflow across the apply form, personal next-step page, delivery APIs, admin follow-up views, analytics privacy controls and scheduled retries.

sections.readerQuestion: Can readers rely on the corrected newsletter reach and stable Core Training Guide delivery introduced on main?
sections.usefulAnswer: The inherited main revision retains the corrected 23,000-reader proof, attribution handling and verified PDF route.
sections.evidence: Main already carried exact-revision publication evidence for these surfaces before the Not Done Yet branch was reconciled.
sections.editorialDecision: Preserve the reviewed main-branch work without reopening or weakening its claims.

sections.readerQuestion: What happens when I submit my coaching application?
sections.usefulAnswer: With the feature enabled, a saved Not Done Yet application immediately offers a join path and a way to ask Sarah; Inner Circle retains its existing process.
sections.evidence: Anthony requested the immediate two-option flow on 8 September 2026. The server flag gates both the workflow and visible copy.
sections.editorialDecision: Replace the contradictory 48-hour promise only while the new flow is enabled and preserve existing copy otherwise.

sections.readerQuestion: How do I join, or ask about the coaching before paying?
sections.usefulAnswer: Applicants can review the programme, choose the stated monthly plan or submit one short question linked to their application for Sarah.
sections.evidence: Anthony specified $195 USD per month and supplied the Skool programme and plan-selection destinations; live offer and link checks will be recorded before publication.
sections.editorialDecision: Keep the two actions explicit and avoid invented urgency, member counts, medical assessment or checkout claims.

sections.location: Application API, database outbox, Beehiiv adapter, cron and Sarah notification sender
sections.readerQuestion: Will applications and questions survive a delivery problem?
sections.usefulAnswer: The application and email job commit together; questions save before notification; known failures retry within bounds while uncertain enrollments stop for inspection.
sections.evidence: Focused source and integration checks cover deduplication, opt-outs, marker ordering, saved questions and retry boundaries; final live evidence will be added after setup.
sections.editorialDecision: Use precise delivery states, preserve opt-outs and payment state, and never equate checkout interest with payment.

sections.readerQuestion: Can staff see who needs a reply without exposing a personal action token?
sections.usefulAnswer: Authenticated staff can see delivery and question status, while analytics and referrer leakage are suppressed on the personal next-step page.
sections.evidence: The implementation uses existing admin authentication and keeps personal tokens in URL fragments and POST bodies rather than query strings.
sections.editorialDecision: Expose useful operational states only to staff and scope analytics suppression to the personal action surface.

claimsAndSources: The Not Done Yet price and workflow come from Anthony's instruction; Sarah's address and ownership are confirmed in repository configuration. Existing main-branch audience and PDF claims remain unchanged. Final live offer and provider evidence will be recorded before publication.
examplesAndReasoning: The suitability screen is a deterministic goal, time and injury/comeback routing rule, not a medical or human assessment. No training prescription or member result is invented.
voiceAndCuts: The copy uses two direct next steps, removes the enabled-flow 48-hour holding message and avoids generic urgency or unsupported promises.
desktopReview: Pending final rendered review of the reconciled revision at a desktop viewport of at least 1000 CSS pixels.
mobileReview: Pending final rendered review of the reconciled revision at a mobile viewport between 320 and 480 CSS pixels.
productAndOfferAccuracy: The feature remains disabled until the $195 USD monthly Skool option, dedicated Beehiiv automation, merge-tag button destinations and reply-to behavior are verified.
